description: Reframe a video to a different aspect ratio (e.g. 16:9 master -> 9:16 vertical): the whole original frame is kept and the new canvas around it is generated, with the sound and timing unchanged. Clips up to 300 seconds. Paid render; returns the served URL of the reframed video. Every placement at once (a free blur-pad by default): repurpose_video. A presenter on any video: add_presenter.

expected_credits.description: the get_cost price; refused unbilled if the live price differs

get_cost.description: true: return the price only; nothing runs or bills

idempotency_key.description: chosen once, resent unchanged on retries: the same key never buys twice

video.description: the source video URL; a URL, not a local file path; use upload_file for local files

name: reframe_video
title: Reframe video
